item_short_desc: Rothco’s Scrambled Eggs Military patch is made of a cotton/polyester blend material and features an adhesive back, which cannot be seen, for easy application.
description: Rothco’s Scrambled Eggs Military patch is made of a cotton/polyester blend material and features an adhesive back.  Worn by military officers, the phrase Scrambled Eggs became a slang term for the gold leaf-shaped embellishments worn on their caps. The military patch measures 4” x 2” in size.
